# Regex to Automaton & Kleene's Theorem

This notebook explores the complete cycle of **Kleene's Theorem**. 
You can type any Regular Expression. The notebook will automatically compile it into a Non-Deterministic Finite Automaton (NFA) using **Thompson's Construction**, number its states, and allow you to explore the $R_{i,j}^k$ sub-languages used in the state elimination method.

Remember that $R_{i,j}^k$ represents the language (set of words) that takes the automaton from state $q_i$ to $q_j$ passing **only** through intermediate states with index $\le k$.

The key recurrence is:
$$
  R_{i,j}^k =
  R_{i,j}^{k-1}
  +
  R_{i,k}^{k-1}(R_{k,k}^{k-1})^*R_{k,j}^{k-1}
$$

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const EPS = "ε";
  const EMPTY = "∅";

  // --- REGEX PARSER ---
  class RegexParser {
    constructor(str) { this.str = str.replace(/\s+/g, ''); this.pos = 0; }
    peek() { return this.pos < this.str.length ? this.str[this.pos] : null; }
    eat(char) { if (this.peek() === char) { this.pos++; return true; } return false; }
    
    parse() {
      if (this.str.length === 0) return { type: 'eps' };
      const res = this.parseE();
      if (this.pos < this.str.length) throw new Error("Unexpected character at " + this.pos);
      return res;
    }
    parseE() {
      let frag = this.parseT();
      while (this.eat('+')) frag = { type: 'union', left: frag, right: this.parseT() };
      return frag;
    }
    parseT() {
      let frag = this.parseF();
      while (this.peek() && this.peek() !== '+' && this.peek() !== ')') {
        frag = { type: 'concat', left: frag, right: this.parseF() };
      }
      return frag;
    }
    parseF() {
      let frag = this.parseB();
      while (this.eat('*')) frag = { type: 'star', inner: frag };
      return frag;
    }
    parseB() {
      if (this.eat('(')) {
        let frag = this.parseE();
        if (!this.eat(')')) throw new Error("Missing closing parenthesis");
        return frag;
      }
      let c = this.peek();
      if (c && /[a-z0-9]/i.test(c)) {
        this.pos++;
        return { type: 'symbol', char: c };
      }
      if (c === EPS) {
         this.pos++;
         return { type: 'eps' };
      }
      throw new Error("Unexpected character: " + c);
    }
  }

  // --- THOMPSON CONSTRUCTION ---
  let stateCounter = 1;
  function newState() { return "q" + (stateCounter++); }

  function compileAST(ast) {
    if (ast.type === 'eps') {
      let s1 = newState(), s2 = newState();
      let t = {}; t[s1] = {}; t[s1][EPS] = [s2];
      return { start: s1, end: s2, transitions: t, alphabet: new Set() };
    }
    if (ast.type === 'symbol') {
      let s1 = newState(), s2 = newState();
      let t = {}; t[s1] = {}; t[s1][ast.char] = [s2];
      return { start: s1, end: s2, transitions: t, alphabet: new Set([ast.char]) };
    }
    if (ast.type === 'concat') {
      let left = compileAST(ast.left);
      let right = compileAST(ast.right);
      let t = Object.assign({}, left.transitions, right.transitions);
      if (!t[left.end]) t[left.end] = {};
      if (!t[left.end][EPS]) t[left.end][EPS] = [];
      t[left.end][EPS].push(right.start);
      return { start: left.start, end: right.end, transitions: t, alphabet: new Set([...left.alphabet, ...right.alphabet]) };
    }
    if (ast.type === 'union') {
      let left = compileAST(ast.left);
      let right = compileAST(ast.right);
      let s1 = newState(), s2 = newState();
      let t = Object.assign({}, left.transitions, right.transitions);
      t[s1] = {}; t[s1][EPS] = [left.start, right.start];
      if (!t[left.end]) t[left.end] = {};
      if (!t[left.end][EPS]) t[left.end][EPS] = [];
      t[left.end][EPS].push(s2);
      if (!t[right.end]) t[right.end] = {};
      if (!t[right.end][EPS]) t[right.end][EPS] = [];
      t[right.end][EPS].push(s2);
      return { start: s1, end: s2, transitions: t, alphabet: new Set([...left.alphabet, ...right.alphabet]) };
    }
    if (ast.type === 'star') {
      let inner = compileAST(ast.inner);
      let s1 = newState(), s2 = newState();
      let t = Object.assign({}, inner.transitions);
      t[s1] = {}; t[s1][EPS] = [inner.start, s2];
      if (!t[inner.end]) t[inner.end] = {};
      if (!t[inner.end][EPS]) t[inner.end][EPS] = [];
      t[inner.end][EPS].push(inner.start, s2);
      return { start: s1, end: s2, transitions: t, alphabet: inner.alphabet };
    }
  }

  function compileRegex(regexStr) {
    stateCounter = 1;
    const parser = new RegexParser(regexStr);
    const ast = parser.parse();
    const nfaData = compileAST(ast);
    const statesSet = new Set([nfaData.start, nfaData.end]);
    for (const s in nfaData.transitions) {
      statesSet.add(s);
      for (const sym in nfaData.transitions[s]) {
        nfaData.transitions[s][sym].forEach(t => statesSet.add(t));
      }
    }
    const states = Array.from(statesSet).sort((a,b) => parseInt(a.substring(1)) - parseInt(b.substring(1)));
    const alphabet = Array.from(nfaData.alphabet);
    alphabet.push(EPS);
    
    states.forEach(s => { if (!nfaData.transitions[s]) nfaData.transitions[s] = {}; });
    
    return {
      states,
      alphabet,
      initial: nfaData.start,
      finals: [nfaData.end],
      transitions: nfaData.transitions
    };
  }

  // --- R_i,j^k LOGIC ---
  function stateNumber(state) { return Number(state.slice(1)); }
  function labelR(i, j, k) { return "R_" + stateNumber(i) + "," + stateNumber(j) + "^" + k; }

  function unionExpr(a, b) {
    if (a === EMPTY) return b;
    if (b === EMPTY) return a;
    if (a === b) return a;
    return a + " + " + b;
  }
  function unionMany(parts) {
    return parts.reduce((acc, part) => unionExpr(acc, part), EMPTY);
  }
  function wrapConcat(expr) {
    if (expr === EPS || expr === EMPTY) return expr;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(expr)) return expr;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]\*$/i.test(expr)) return expr;
    if (/^\(.+\)\*$/.test(expr)) return expr;
    return "(" + expr + ")";
  }
  function concatExpr() {
    const parts = Array.from(arguments);
    if (parts.some((part) => part === EMPTY)) return EMPTY;
    const real = parts.filter((part) => part !== EPS);
    if (real.length === 0) return EPS;
    return real.map(wrapConcat).join("");
  }
  function starExpr(expr) {
    if (expr === EMPTY || expr === EPS) return EPS;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(expr)) return expr + "*";
    if (expr.endsWith("*") && !expr.includes("+")) return expr;
    return "(" + expr + ")*";
  }

  function buildExpressions(aut) {
    const levels = [];
    levels[0] = {};
    aut.states.forEach((from) => {
      levels[0][from] = {};
      aut.states.forEach((to) => {
        const parts = [];
        if (from === to) parts.push(EPS);
        aut.alphabet.forEach((symbol) => {
          if (aut.transitions[from] && aut.transitions[from][symbol] && aut.transitions[from][symbol].includes(to)) {
             parts.push(symbol);
          }
        });
        levels[0][from][to] = unionMany(parts);
      });
    });

    for (let k = 1; k <= aut.states.length; k += 1) {
      const qk = aut.states[k - 1];
      levels[k] = {};
      aut.states.forEach((from) => {
        levels[k][from] = {};
        aut.states.forEach((to) => {
          const direct = levels[k - 1][from][to];
          const via = concatExpr(
            levels[k - 1][from][qk],
            starExpr(levels[k - 1][qk][qk]),
            levels[k - 1][qk][to]
          );
          levels[k][from][to] = unionExpr(direct, via);
        });
      });
    }
    return levels;
  }

  function belongsToR_NFA(aut, start, end, k, word) {
    function search(currentState, wordIndex, visited) {
      if (wordIndex === word.length && currentState === end) return true;
      let key = currentState + "-" + wordIndex;
      if (visited.has(key)) return false;
      visited.add(key);
      
      let res = false;
      if (aut.transitions[currentState] && aut.transitions[currentState][EPS]) {
        for (let next of aut.transitions[currentState][EPS]) {
           if (next === end || stateNumber(next) <= k) {
              if (search(next, wordIndex, visited)) return true;
           }
        }
      }
      if (wordIndex < word.length) {
        let sym = word[wordIndex];
        if (aut.transitions[currentState] && aut.transitions[currentState][sym]) {
          for (let next of aut.transitions[currentState][sym]) {
             if (next === end || stateNumber(next) <= k) {
                if (search(next, wordIndex + 1, visited)) return true;
             }
          }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    return search(start, 0, new Set());
  }

  function runNFAFull(aut, word) {
    function eclose(states) {
      let queue = [...states];
      let closed = new Set(states);
      while (queue.length > 0) {
        let q = queue.shift();
        if (aut.transitions[q] && aut.transitions[q][EPS]) {
          aut.transitions[q][EPS].forEach(t => {
            if (!closed.has(t)) { closed.add(t); queue.push(t); }
          });
        }
      }
      return Array.from(closed);
    }
    
    let current = eclose([aut.initial]);
    for (const symbol of word) {
      let next = new Set();
      current.forEach(q => {
        if (aut.transitions[q] && aut.transitions[q][symbol]) {
          aut.transitions[q][symbol].forEach(t => next.add(t));
        }
      });
      current = eclose(Array.from(next));
    }
    return current.some(q => aut.finals.includes(q));
  }

  function allWords(alphabet, maxLength) {
    const realAlph = alphabet.filter(a => a !== EPS);
    const words = [""];
    let layer = [""];
    for (let length = 1; length <= maxLength; length += 1) {
      const next = [];
      layer.forEach((prefix) => {
        realAlph.forEach((symbol) => next.push(prefix + symbol));
      });
      words.push.apply(words, next);
      layer = next;
    }
    return words;
  }

  // --- UI CONTROLS ---
  const regexInput = document.getElementById("ke-regex");
  const kSelect = document.getElementById("ke-k");
  const iSelect = document.getElementById("ke-i");
  const jSelect = document.getElementById("ke-j");
  const selected = document.getElementById("ke-selected");
  const components = document.getElementById("ke-components");
  const examples = document.getElementById("ke-examples");
  const wordInput = document.getElementById("ke-word");
  const verdict = document.getElementById("ke-verdict");
  const legend = document.getElementById("ke-node-legend");
  const errorDiv = document.getElementById("ke-error");

  let currentAut = null;
  let currentLevels = null;
  let network = null;
  let blockRender = false;

  function updateAutomaton() {
    try {
      errorDiv.style.display = 'none';
      if (!regexInput.value.trim()) return;
      currentAut = compileRegex(regexInput.value);
      currentLevels = buildExpressions(currentAut);
      
      blockRender = true;
      kSelect.innerHTML = "";
      for (let k = 0; k <= currentAut.states.length; k += 1) {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = String(k);
        option.textContent = String(k);
        kSelect.appendChild(option);
      }
      kSelect.value = String(currentAut.states.length);

      [iSelect, jSelect].forEach((select) => {
        select.innerHTML = "";
        currentAut.states.forEach((state) => {
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = state;
          option.textContent = state;
          select.appendChild(option);
        });
      });
      iSelect.value = currentAut.initial;
      jSelect.value = currentAut.finals[0];
      blockRender = false;
      
      render();
    } catch (e) {
      errorDiv.textContent = "Regex Error: " + e.message;
      errorDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function renderGraph(aut, i, j, k) {
    const container = document.getElementById('ke-vis-graph');
    
    const nodes = aut.states.map(s => {
      let color = '#daf3fc';
      let border = '#30bced';
      let borderWidth = 2;
      
      const isStart = s === i;
      const isEnd = s === j;
      const isAccept = aut.finals.includes(s);
      const isAllowed = stateNumber(s) <= k && k > 0;
      
      if (isAllowed) { color = '#e8d5f5'; border = '#9b59b6'; }
      if (isAccept) { color = '#d4f7ef'; if (!isAllowed) border = '#2ec4b6'; }
      if (isStart) { borderWidth = 4; border = '#fc5130'; }
      else if (isEnd) { borderWidth = 4; border = '#1f8fb7'; }
      
      return {
        id: s, label: s, shape: 'circle',
        color: { background: color, border: border },
        borderWidth: borderWidth,
        font: { size: 16, face: 'monospace', bold: true }
      };
    });
    
    nodes.push({ id: 'invisible_start', shape: 'dot', size: 0, opacity: 0 });
    const edges = [];
    edges.push({ from: 'invisible_start', to: aut.initial, label: 'start', arrows: 'to', font: {align: 'horizontal'}, color: '#fc5130' });
    
    aut.states.forEach(from => {
      let targets = {};
      aut.alphabet.forEach(sym => {
        if (aut.transitions[from] && aut.transitions[from][sym]) {
           aut.transitions[from][sym].forEach(to => {
              if (!targets[to]) targets[to] = [];
              targets[to].push(sym);
           });
        }
      });
      for (let to in targets) {
         edges.push({
            from: from, to: to, label: targets[to].join(','),
            arrows: 'to', font: { align: 'horizontal' },
            color: '#303036', smooth: { type: 'curvedCW', roundness: 0.2 }
         });
      }
    });
    
    const data = { nodes: new vis.DataSet(nodes), edges: new vis.DataSet(edges) };
    const options = {
      layout: { hierarchical: { direction: 'LR', sortMethod: 'directed', nodeSpacing: 60, levelSeparation: 120 } },
      physics: false,
      edges: { width: 2, font: { size: 14, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' } }
    };
    
    if (network) {
       network.setData(data);
    } else {
       network = new vis.Network(container, data, options);
    }
    
    legend.innerHTML = "";
    [
      ["start", i], ["end", j],
      ["allowed intermediates", k === 0 ? "none" : aut.states.slice(0, k).join(", ")],
      ["accepting", aut.finals.join(", ")]
    ].forEach(([name, value]) => {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge";
      badge.textContent = name + ": " + value;
      legend.appendChild(badge);
    });
  }

  function renderComponents(aut, levels, i, j, k) {
    components.innerHTML = "";
    if (k === 0) {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.className = "ke-desc";
      p.textContent = "At k = 0 there are no intermediate states. Only epsilon on the diagonal and direct one-symbol transitions can appear.";
      components.appendChild(p);
      return;
    }

    const qk = aut.states[k - 1];
    const rows = [
      ["avoid q" + k, labelR(i, j, k - 1), levels[k - 1][i][j]],
      ["enter q" + k, labelR(i, qk, k - 1), levels[k - 1][i][qk]],
      ["repeat at q" + k, "(" + labelR(qk, qk, k - 1) + ")*", starExpr(levels[k - 1][qk][qk])],
      ["exit q" + k, labelR(qk, j, k - 1), levels[k - 1][qk][j]]
    ];

    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "ke-table";
    table.innerHTML = "<thead><tr><th>Part</th><th>Symbol</th><th>Expression</th></tr></thead>";
    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      row.forEach((cell) => {
        const td = document.createElement("td");
        td.textContent = cell;
        tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    components.appendChild(table);
  }

  function renderExamples(aut, i, j, k) {
    examples.innerHTML = "";
    const hits = allWords(aut.alphabet, 4).filter((word) => belongsToR_NFA(aut, i, j, k, word));
    if (hits.length === 0) {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge warn";
      badge.textContent = "no words up to length 4";
      examples.appendChild(badge);
      return;
    }
    hits.forEach((word) => {
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "ke-badge";
      badge.textContent = word === "" ? EPS : word;
      examples.appendChild(badge);
    });
  }

  function renderWordTest(aut, i, j, k) {
    const clean = wordInput.value.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, "").toLowerCase();
    if (clean !== wordInput.value) wordInput.value = clean;
    
    const selectedHit = belongsToR_NFA(aut, i, j, k, clean);
    const languageHit = runNFAFull(aut, clean);

    const selectedText = selectedHit ? "belongs to " : "does not belong to ";
    const acceptedText = languageHit ? "accepted by the NFA" : "rejected by the NFA";
    verdict.textContent =
      (clean === "" ? EPS : clean) + " " + selectedText + labelR(i, j, k) +
      "; from the real initial state it is " + acceptedText + ".";
  }

  function render() {
    if (blockRender || !currentAut) return;
    const k = Number(kSelect.value);
    const i = iSelect.value;
    const j = jSelect.value;
    
    selected.textContent = labelR(i, j, k) + " = " + currentLevels[k][i][j];
    renderGraph(currentAut, i, j, k);
    renderComponents(currentAut, currentLevels, i, j, k);
    renderExamples(currentAut, i, j, k);
    renderWordTest(currentAut, i, j, k);
  }

  regexInput.addEventListener("input", updateAutomaton);
  [kSelect, iSelect, jSelect].forEach((select) => select.addEventListener("change", render));
  wordInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
    if(currentAut) renderWordTest(currentAut, iSelect.value, jSelect.value, Number(kSelect.value));
  });

  // initial setup
  updateAutomaton();
})();
</script>
```
